notes: Zooz models. Every group number here comes from tests/fixtures/z2_associations.json, captured live from Jayant's network, and the test suite cross-checks each one against that fixture. The 'semantics': 'unknown' markers exist because of Stage 0 item Z7, which is still open: nobody has observed what value a Zooz small button sends to its Pressed group, so it may be a fixed OFF or it may toggle. Until Z7 is closed, the compiler must warn before putting the Off-all template on one of these emitters, because a toggle turns the lights back on every second press. Do not delete these markers as noise. Closing Z7 needs the controller inside a small button's Pressed group while Jayant physically presses it twice; see docs/stage0-report.md.

devices.notes: One main paddle plus four small scene buttons. Group layout captured from nodes 36 and 39. The main paddle has a real off press, so it carries no semantics marker; the four small buttons are the ones Z7 is about.

800LR wall remote, four buttons, group capacity 5 rather than 10. Buttons 1 and 2 act as one on/off pair and buttons 3 and 4 as another, each pair with its own dimming group. Groups 6 to 9 are the vendor's per-button Toggle Control groups, and they carry the semantics marker because a group the vendor itself calls Toggle is the exact case Off-all cannot use. This node is battery powered, so writes stay pending until it wakes; no wake_instruction is recorded because Stage 0 item Z4 was never approved and the wake sequence was never observed. No settings adapters: node 40's config values were not captured, so there is nothing to validate them against.
